dashboard-10000-jobs.description: 10,000 persisted inert jobs paged 200 at a time through all 50 dashboard pages in the packaged application with a 512 MiB maximum heap. Local reference (2026-10-26, Chrome 149, JDK 21): 93,492 bytes per page, 5.0 MB total, 30 MB browser heap, 1.7 s slowest page, 4,328 DOM nodes, 906 MB server RSS, 53 threads, 50 descriptors.

fake-engine-workflow.description: Upload, explicit start, restart, retry, source inspection and a failed disk-full attempt of fake-engine reconstructions in the packaged application with a 512 MiB maximum heap. Local reference (2026-10-26): 35-42 KB API payload, 9 MB browser heap, 194 MB server RSS, 58 threads, 53 descriptors.
